verdict.summary_en: Order acknowledgement OA25605076 from Boise Semiconductor Inc. to Soony Interactive GmbH for PO 4500318538 dated 2025-08-08. One line: item 00010, CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5, 10,000 units at 6.11 USD, confirmed for 2025-09-11. The terms are EXW Boise with payment NET30. The document has no handwritten corrections or stamps.
red_flags: Terms conflict: the document says EXW Boise and that DDP is not agreed. It also says freight, insurance and duties are prepaid by Seller and added to the invoice. Under EXW the buyer normally arranges and pays freight, so the added charges need to be clarified.
The confirmed quantity is not stated separately. The Qty column of 10,000 is the only quantity shown.
No total price and no document date are shown.
observations: Clean, typed single-page PDF. No handwriting, stamps, signatures or strike-throughs.
The Qty column is not labelled as ordered or confirmed. It is recorded as quantity_ordered.
The Confirmed column holds a date only, which is recorded as date_confirmed.
